senses.gloss: m. (preced.; v. בָּלַם) halter, trnsf. guard, protection of the borders of a field, as fences &c.; cmp. אַפְסָרָא.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 103b:10">B. Mets. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>כל עיקר ב׳ וכ׳</he> whatever is essential for guarding the limits, the landlord must provide. [Ms. M. <he>כלומ׳</he>, Ar. <he>כלמי</he>, v. <cite ref="K00764"><he>כְּלָמָא</he></cite>.]
